name: ShopSlot – Auto Repair & Detailing Appointment Booking
author: SlotWorks

sections.description:
Let customers book predictable service appointments on your WordPress site with [shopslot_booking]. ShopSlot Free is built for auto repair, RV, marine, detailing and other specialty shops. Customers choose an available service time; Free confirms the booking when it is saved.

ShopSlot Free provides reliable instant booking with unlimited services. Configure services, weekly availability, lead times, booking horizons, blackout dates, customer details, and appointment status history from WordPress.

What you get in ShopSlot Free

  • Unlimited services for predictable appointment types
  • Weekly availability, lead times, and booking horizons
  • Blackout dates and extra-hours overrides
  • Conflict checks before a slot is confirmed
  • Appointment review with status history
  • A customer booking form placed with the [shopslot_booking] shortcode

ShopSlot Pro (optional, sold separately)

Pro is a separate optional paid add-on. See the product website for current availability, features and requirements. Free works without Pro. See shopslot.app.

Switching from another booking plugin

The read-only Migration Center can identify familiar scheduling-plugin installations and produce sanitized inventory evidence without changing source data or exposing customer values. This release has no self-service import button.

ShopSlot does not include invoicing, accounting, or inventory management.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shopslot folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate ShopSlot.
  3. Add services and configure availability under ShopSlot in the WordPress administrator.
  4. Place the [shopslot_booking] shortcode on the page where customers should book.

Back up the site before replacing another scheduling system. The Migration Center in this release is read-only and does not modify another plugin’s records.
sections.faq:
Is ShopSlot Free usable on its own?

Yes. ShopSlot Free includes instant booking with unlimited services, availability rules, blackout dates, and appointment status history. Pro is optional.

What does ShopSlot Pro add?

Pro is a separate optional paid add-on. See the product website for current availability, features and requirements. Free works without Pro. See shopslot.app.

How do customers book?

Add the [shopslot_booking] shortcode to any page. Customers choose a service and an available time from that form.

Can I import appointments from another booking plugin?

Not with a self-service button in this release. The Migration Center is read-only. It can inventory a supported source installation without changing that plugin’s records.

Does ShopSlot handle invoices, parts, or inventory?

No. ShopSlot is for scheduling. It does not include invoicing, accounting, or inventory management.
sections.changelog:
0.19.1

  • Make Save without notifying always save silently, even when an older form includes a checked notification value.
  • Use explicit Save and notify customer / Save without notifying actions.

0.19.0

  • Kept the Migration Center read-only for public use, with no import, rollback, or cutover action.
  • Internal migration testing work for SSA, Amelia, and Bookly. No self-service import is available.

0.3.0 – 0.18.0

  • Appointment CSV export, notification-log retention controls, accessibility improvements, and the read-only Migration Center inventory.
  • Removed the artificial active-service cap.

0.2.0 – 0.2.2

  • Generated availability slots with weekly hours, lead time, booking horizon, blackout and extra-hours overrides, and conflict revalidation.
  • Vehicle suggestion fields with make-specific model filtering.

0.1.0

  • Initial private developer preview.
